title: HISTORY PAPER 2 FORM
text:
311/2
 HISTORY & GOVERNMENT
 PAPER 2
 TIME: 2 ½ HOURS
 Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (K.C.S.E)
 311/2
 History & Government
 Paper 2
 2 ½ HOURS
 INSTRUCTIONS TO CANDIDATES
  This paper consists of three sections; A, B and C.
  Answer ALL the questions in section A, THREE questions from section B and TWO questions
 from section C.
  Answers to all the questions MUST be written on the answer sheets provided.
 FOR EXAMINER’S USE ONLY
 QUESTION SCORE
 SECTION A 1 - 17
 SECTION B 19
 SECTION C 22
 TOTAL SCORE
 This paper consists of 2 printed pages .Candidates should check the question paper to ensure that all pages are printed as indicated
 and no questions are missing
 SECTION A: (25 MARKS)
 Answer all the questions in this section in the answer booklet provided.
 1. What is anthropology as a source of information on History and Government. (1mk)
 2. Identify two activities that influenced early man to set up permanent settlement. (2mks)
 3. Name two inventories that made early agriculture in Egypt to succeed. (2mks)
 4. State two characteristics of silent trade. (2mks)
 5. State one political factor that led to the decline of trans-saharan trade. (1mk)
 6. Identify two improvements that have been made on modern road from macadamied roads.
 (2mks)
 7. Which is the quickest traditional method of sending a message to many people over a
 wider area? (1mk)
 8. State the main use of steam energy during the Industrial revolution. (1mk)
 9. Give two scientific inventions of the twentieth century which has led to the reduction
 in death rates. (2mks)
 10. Give one reason for the decline of Athens as an early urban centre. (1mk)
 11. Identify one territorial dispute that made it necessary to convene the Berlin conference. (1mk)
 12. State two reasons why Britain used direct rule in Zimbabwe. (2mks)
 13. State two roles played by the united states of America to end the first world war. (2mks)
 14. Identify two treaties signed between Lobengula and the British. (2mks)
 15. Identify the main difference between membership into the House of Lords and the House of
 Commons in Britain. (1mk)
 16. Give one agency of the United Nations Organizations that deals with the Welfare of children
 in the world. (1mk)
 17. Which organ of the African Union is in charges of the day to day running of the
 operations of the organization? (1mk)
 SECTION B: (45 MARKS)
 Answer any three questions from this section.
 18. (a) State three effects of land endosure system in Britain during the agrarian-revolution. (3mks)
 (b) Explain six disadvantages of open filed – system on agriculture before the agrarian
 revolution. (12mks)
 19. (a) Identify five factors for the growth of the Asante empire. (5mks)
 (b) Explain five social feature of the Baganda Kingdom. (10mks)
 20. (a) Name three countries in North Africa Colonized by the French. (3mks)
 (b)Explain six factors that facilitated European colonization of Africa. (12mks)
 21. (a) State three ways used by Nationalists in Ghana to fight for independence. (3mks)
 (b) State six factors that led to Africa –nationalism in Ghana (12mks)
 SECTION C: (30 MARKS)
 Answer any two questions from this section
 22. (a) State three benefits of the East African community to the member states upto 1977 (3mks)
 (b) Explain six factors that made pan-Africanism popular in Africa After 1945. (12mks)
 23. (a) Give three political challenges which Tanzania has faced since independence. (3mks)
 (b) Explain six effects of the cold war in the world. (12mks)
 24. (a) Give three functions of the Monarchy in Britain. (3mks )
 (b)Explain the functions of federal government of the united state of America. (12mks)
